summary: RETEST after iteration-1 fixes. Extended the pytest suite from 67 to 74 cases (new TestFixRegressions class) — ALL 74 PASS, including the three previously-failing cases (test_brute_force_lockout, test_undo_seen_within_window, test_undo_seen_blocked_after_transcription). New backend assertions verify: public unauthenticated GET /api/camps/active/public (camp + today's day, no PHI/_id), desk register rejects missing/short phone with a clear message, undo-seen preserves printed_at while clearing seen_at (verified by re-GET), OT seat released when an OT deferral is re-recorded on a different day (net seats_taken correct), lockout returns 401x5 then 429,429 with no 500 and is email-keyed (a different email is unaffected, admin login unaffected). Frontend (Playwright, desktop 1920x1080 + mobile 390x844): /self-register now loads via the public endpoint and the full flow works (generate demo card -> Scan/Decode locks identity -> submit -> receipt #12 with patient QR); Modal is portaled to document.body (header top=+129px, close button clickable with a normal click, body overflow locked and restored) on desktop and mobile for New Registration / Add Staff / Correction; New Registration submits successfully and shows 'A valid 10-digit household mobile number is required' when phone is missing; print A4 renders with QR, mark-seen refused with 'This patient's prescription was never printed.' before print, mark-seen then Undo works from the desk UI keeping the Printed badge; clinical correction now refetches (BP 140/90 -> 155/99 immediately on screen and after reload); Login.js navigate-during-render warning is GONE (verified both on login and when revisiting /login while authenticated -> redirects to /admin); admin tabs (Camps & Days, Staff, OT Schedule, Leaderboards, Exports) all render, CSV download works (camp_records.csv), staff create with password policy works. All 8 reported regressions are fixed. Only minor issues remain.

minor.issue: ot_eye has no server-side validation (Optional[str]); the UI submits R/L/B while the API happily stores arbitrary values such as 'left'/'right'. A record stored via API with 'left' renders as '—' in the UI select (silent display data-loss). Add Literal['R','L','B'] validation (or normalise) in models.py.
Still CORS_ORIGINS default '*' with allow_credentials=True for a PHI app (carried over from iteration 1); recommend explicit origin list.
Still no TTL index on login_attempts (only identifier_1 / locked_until_1); lock documents accumulate forever.

ui_bugs.issue: When the server rejects a weak password (400), the modal stays open but shows NO error banner — only the static hint '>=12 chars, upper/lower/digit/symbol'. The New Registration modal does surface its 400 message, so this is inconsistent; surface detail/message here too.
Select options use values R/L/B but stored/API values can be 'right'/'left'/'both' -> select falls back to '—' and a subsequent save could wipe the stored value. Align frontend/backend vocabulary.
Public patient page still fires GET /api/auth/me on mount -> 401 in the browser console on every load (cosmetic, page works). Skip the auth bootstrap on public routes.

Register button is enabled with no phone entered; the failure is only discovered after a 400 round-trip. Client-side disable/inline validation would be cleaner (server message is clear, so low priority).

issues: Accumulated duplicate 'TEST volunteer'/'TEST vol2' rows from prior test runs (test-data noise, not a product bug) — all 0 pts, so the ranking view looks empty/meaningless
Unchanged from iteration 1: bare page with only an alert + 'Back to desk', no header/branding (low priority)

action_items: Validate/normalise ot_eye (backend Literal['R','L','B'] or map to UI values) so stored values always render in the clinical select.
Show the server error message in the Add Staff modal when password policy / duplicate email is rejected.
Skip the /api/auth/me bootstrap on public routes (/self-register) to stop the 401 console error.
Optional hardening carried over: explicit CORS origins for a PHI app, TTL index on login_attempts.
critical_code_review_comments: helpers.as_utc() is now used at the two known naive/aware sites (routes_desk.undo_seen, routes_auth login lockout) and both are verified fixed; worth a repo-wide grep to ensure any future Mongo datetime comparison goes through as_utc().
Clinical transcription free-text/enum fields (ot_eye, gender) are unvalidated Optional[str]; enumerate them in Pydantic to prevent silent UI/DB vocabulary drift.

OT seat accounting now compensates on replacement (verified net seats_taken: OT A 0/3 after moving the booking to OT B 1/3) — keep this covered by the regression test test_ot_seat_released_on_rerecord.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all regression flows pass; 2 medium cosmetic/validation issues)

rca_of_the_issue: No new root causes. Remaining minor ot_eye issue: models.TranscriptionIn.ot_eye is Optional[str] with no enum, so API writers can store 'left' while Clinical.js only understands 'R'/'L'/'B'; the controlled <select value={rx.ot_eye}> then falls back to the empty option, showing '—' and risking overwrite on save.
